unblock_request.finding_site: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py:1559-1561 (review-before-merge exact-head path merges origin/dev into a disposable worktree of the exact reviewed head to distinguish staleness from a real conflict; the merge failed non-zero here)

root_cause.mechanism: PR #5892's reviewed head (ab5cb3298) was cut from dev base f15be762e. Between approval and integration, PR #5887 (BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-CB04-GOVERNANCE-APPROVALS-AUDIT-001) merged into dev and reclassified 14 test files from PLANNED to DECOUPLED in the same generated file, services/control-plane/bff/tests/bff_test_architecture_inventory.json, that PR #5892 also edits (it moves test_bff_b3_trading_pulse.py from PLANNED to MIGRATED). Both PRs touched the same aggregate summary fields (disposition_summary counts, live_scan_non_whitelisted_main_importer_ceiling, and the sorted live_scan_non_whitelisted_main_importers list) in overlapping JSON regions, producing a real text conflict, not ordinary staleness.
root_cause.conflict_scope: Exactly 3 line ranges conflicted: disposition_summary (DECOUPLED/MIGRATED/PLANNED counts), live_scan_non_whitelisted_main_importer_ceiling, and one position in the sorted live_scan_non_whitelisted_main_importers array. Every per-file entry in the tests[] array, composition_allowlist, and migrated_suites merged cleanly with git's line-based merge because the two PRs touched disjoint file entries there.
root_cause.integrator_disposition: No auto_integrator.py change needed. The exact-head review-before-merge path correctly distinguished a genuine merge conflict from staleness (scripts/git/auto_integrator.py:1548-1561) and correctly refused to push or queue the candidate. This is the designed fail-closed behavior, not a bug.

remediation.method: Merged origin/dev into the reviewed PR branch, resolved the 3-region conflict by recomputing the generated aggregate fields from the merged tests[] array plus a live AST re-scan (services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_test_architecture.py::_live_scan_non_whitelisted_main_importers), rather than guessing merged counts by hand. Pushed the resulting merge commit directly to task/BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-CB05-STRATEGY-CAPITAL-RANKING-001 (fast-forward from the old head; no force push).

resolution_detail.merge_method: 3-way merge of the tests[] array keyed by "file": for every one of the 384 entries, at most one side differed from the common ancestor (no true per-entry conflicts existed); disposition_summary was then recomputed as a fresh count over the merged 384 entries and matches ALLOWLIST(15)+DECOUPLED(292)+MIGRATED(12)+PLANNED(65)=384=total_test_files.
resolution_detail.ceiling_method: Ran the exact live-AST-scan helper from test_bff_test_architecture.py against the merged worktree's on-disk test files and the merged composition_allowlist; live scan found 65 non-whitelisted main importers (dev's 66 minus test_bff_b3_trading_pulse.py, which PR #5892 migrates off main). live_scan_non_whitelisted_main_importers was set to exactly that live-scanned, sorted list; ceiling set to 65, which is lower than both parent ceilings, honoring the gate's never-raise rule.
